question: Simplify (1)/((sin²⁾A⁾ - 1 where 0 < A ≤ 90º
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Use standard **trigonometric identity** 1/sin²A = cosec²A. Expression becomes: **cosec²A − 1**. By identity: **cosec²A − 1 = cot²A**. Alternatively, put **A = 45º**: 1/sin²45º − 1 = 1/(1/2) − 1 = 2 − 1 = 1. Checking options: cot²45º = 1. **∴ The correct answer is cot² A.**
